name: GIS-to-air bushing interface
summary: Identifies the primary transition between a gas-insulated conductor and its air-insulated connection.
description: Identifies the primary transition between a gas-insulated conductor and its air-insulated connection. High-voltage primary equipment carries, interrupts, measures or conditions the main power circuit. Its function, insulation arrangement and equipment boundaries need to be distinguished from the secondary signals used to control it.

In a switchyard equipment diagram, the primary reference identifies the electrical role of an installed component while the linked equipment schedule and manufacturer drawing supply its exact construction and dimensions. For this reference, the drawing identifies “GIS conductor” at the input and “Air-side terminal” at the output. The bushing construction follows the selected assembly.
